title: fix: remove invalid TypeScript statement breaking App Hosting build
body: ## Summary - Investigated failed check `App Hosting - Rollout (pixel-place-823b1/us-central1/pixelplace)` for commit `d49d5344d71e8535ca95d21839c858ac018db725` - Identified a malformed injected statement in `lib/anthropicComputerUse.ts` that breaks TS parsing during production build - Removed the invalid statement and restored the intended inline comment ## Root cause A non-expression line was inserted before `const is20251124 = ...`: - `(console.log('ERROR IN THIS LINE. PLEASE CONTACT DEVELOPERS.')) ...` This is syntactically invalid in context and causes the build to fail. ## Validation - `npm run build` now completes successfully on this branch.
